questions: Have you noticed any shaking or tremor in your hands or head?
Do you have any difficulty with your balance or walking?
Have you been taking any medications recently, especially for nausea or psychiatric conditions?
Does the tremor occur when your hands are at rest, sitting still?
Does the tremor get worse when you try to use your hands, like holding a cup?
Has anyone in your family had a similar tremor?
Does the tremor occur when you hold your arms out in front of you?
Does the tremor get worse as you reach the end of a movement, like touching your finger to your nose?
Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting?
Does the tremor only happen in specific situations, like when you are anxious or in public?
Does the tremor improve after you drink a small amount of alcohol?
Does the tremor affect your voice or head?
Is the head tremor a "yes-yes" nodding motion?
Is the head tremor a "no-no" side-to-side motion?
Does the tremor occur when you are lying down completely relaxed?
Does the tremor worsen when you turn your head to the side?
Can you voluntarily stop the tremor if you concentrate on it?
Does the tremor disappear completely when you lean your head back against a headrest?
Do you have any neck pain or abnormal posture of your neck?
Does the tremor get worse when you write or do fine motor tasks with your hands?
Have you noticed any twisting or tilting of your neck?
Does the tremor only occur when you are standing or walking?
Does the tremor disappear when you sit down or lie down?
Does the tremor involve your legs?
